denominators.file_dispositions: processing attempts over unique frozen eligible source IDs; errors and unsupported retained
denominators.messages: all parsed records; source-declared labels separate from verified attribution
denominators.claims: distinct source/message/span/predicate/polarity identity; no claim synthesized from evaluator
denominators.verdicts: all audited claims; verdict counts sum to claims audited; parse dispositions separate
denominators.reference_metrics: eligible independently adjudicated concrete-predicate cases only; development/synthetic excluded
denominators.context: immutable committed batch/member observations; successful recovery count separate from attempted recovery

targets: No prescribed number of SUPPORTED claims; measure actual rejection and abstention
